description: 本地运行的大模型聚合网关，GUI桌面端app，零代码部署，把Coding Plan、大模型 API 额度聚合成一个虚拟 Plan，一键接入 Claude Code、Claude Desktop App、OpenClaw、OpenCode 等工具。Bundle your scattered Token Plan, Coding Plan, and LLM API quotas into a single virtual Plan, and plug it into Claude Code, Claude Desktop App, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and more.
